text:
maria: Heads-up  partner sync request: need final dates for H100/H200 firmware, MI300 microcode sign-off, and Gaudi runtime container hash so marketplace can schedule a soft-launch. Also need embargo window for joint PR. Can @chen @todd confirm?

chen: Nvidia: H100 stable; H200 firmware candidate in staging. They saw a telemetry spike under NVLINK stress  expecting validation result by 05/12.

todd: AMD: MI300 microcode team reports ECC corner-case tests running. ETA for signed microcode image is 05/18-05/20. They offered to run a short regression with our test harness if we provide test vectors.

marie: Gaudi partner says runtime container will be pushed to their registry by 05/10. Ask them for digest rather than tag. We'll fail marketplace QA on mutable tags.

partner-relay-bot: Created ticket PRTN-9087: "collect-pinned-digests-and-embargo-dates" assigned to @maria and @ops 

ops: Marketplace ops: please provide canonical SKU format today. We recommend lowercase with vendor prefix: redwood-hw-<vendor>-<model>-<profile>-v<major>. We'll auto-generate landing pages after digests are pinned.

maria: Proposed embargo: partners prefer 72h, comms/legal want 96h for synchronized global press. If we target week of 05/23, embargo window would be 05/19-05/23. Hold public pages until QA sign-off.

chen: I'll ask Nvidia for the telemetry mitigation details and whether a driver hotfix can be backported. If not, we need to note an "opt-in" profile in SKU metadata.

todd: I'll send MI300 test vectors and request AMD to prioritize ECC regression verification. Also asking for signed image at 05/18.

maria: Action items: 1) Chen confirm H200 validation by 05/12; 2) Todd arrange test vectors + confirm AMD sign-off by 05/20; 3) Marie to collect Gaudi digest by 05/10; 4) Ops to create SKU placeholders and block public pages until digest+QA. Will sync after vendor replies. Thanks everyone :pray:
